items: Initial release of Vault Gallery
AES-256-GCM encryption for all stored photos and videos
Encryption keys stored in Android hardware-backed Keystore; never exposed to the app/device storage
PIN authentication with SHA-256 salted hashing
Biometric unlock support — fingerprint and face recognition
Automatic vault locking when app is backgrounded
Configurable auto-lock timeout — Immediately, 30 seconds, 1, 5, or 15 minutes
Import photos and videos directly from your device gallery
Original files removed from system gallery after import
Encrypted thumbnail generation for smooth private gallery browsing
Full resolution in-memory decryption — no plaintext ever written to disk
Album creation and organization
Favorites collection
Recycle bin with soft delete and one-tap restore
Configurable recycle bin auto-delete — 7, 30, or 60 days
Full text search by filename, album, and tags
Swipe between photos and videos in the media viewer
Pinch to zoom and pan on photos
Video playback with full player controls
Configurable vault storage quota up to 15GB
Real-time vault storage usage display on home screen
Dark cyberpunk UI with Material 3 design
Dynamic color support on Android 12 and newer
Screenshot and screen recording prevention
Brute force PIN protection with progressive lockout
Zero ads
Zero cloud connectivity
Zero data collection
Supports Android 8.0 through Android 14
